title: Content Sovereignty via Null Tenant Layer: Filter at Output, Not Input

abstract: A system and method for content processing in which content filtering occurs at the OUTPUT (publication) boundary rather than the INPUT (imagination) boundary. The architecture introduces a Null Tenant Layer — a content-blind processing enclave between user input and system output — analogous to the biological blood-brain barrier. The system eliminates input scanning entirely, reducing compute cost while simultaneously increasing user privacy. The Null Tenant Layer processes all inputs without inspection, classification, or refusal. Content governance is applied only at the publication boundary, where the USER — not the system — controls what crosses from private imagination into public expression. This inverts the current industry standard of input-side content filtering.
field: Computer Science — Privacy Architecture, Content Moderation, Zero-Knowledge Computing

background.current_state: All major AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Meta) apply content filtering at the INPUT layer. Every user prompt is scanned, classified, and potentially refused before processing begins. This architecture is: (a) computationally expensive — every token must pass through safety classifiers, (b) privacy-invasive — the system must read and understand all user input to filter it, (c) error-prone — false positives block legitimate use, (d) liability-creating — the system has knowledge of the input content, creating legal exposure, (e) trust-destroying — users cannot freely imagine, explore, or create.
background.biological_precedent: The human nervous system does NOT filter at input. The retina sends ALL visual information to the visual cortex. The blood-brain barrier filters by STRUCTURE (molecular size, charge, lipophilicity), not by CONTENT (what the molecule means). The brain processes everything. The human decides what to express. Modesty is at the MOUTH, not the EYE.
background.economic_cost: Industry-wide, content scanning is estimated to consume 15-30% of inference compute. False positive refusals cost customer goodwill and subscription revenue. Legal liability from content awareness creates ongoing risk.

invention.core_claim: A three-layer architecture — PNS/CNS/NULL — where content filtering occurs exclusively at the output boundary, not the input boundary.

layer_1_PNS.name: Peripheral Nervous System (PNS) — Input Layer
layer_1_PNS.function: Receives ALL input without scanning, classification, or refusal
layer_1_PNS.analogy: skin, eyes, ears — nerves reach everywhere, everything is felt
layer_1_PNS.implementation: Standard API endpoint. No content classifier. No safety filter. Input is received as-is.

layer_2_CNS.name: Central Nervous System (CNS) — Processing Trunk
layer_2_CNS.function: Carries signals from PNS to NULL for processing. Filters by STRUCTURE, not CONTENT.
layer_2_CNS.analogy: spinal cord — protected inside bone, carries ALL signals, filters by shape not meaning
layer_2_CNS.implementation: Tenant isolation layer. Validates request STRUCTURE (format, auth, rate limits) without inspecting CONTENT. Like the blood-brain barrier filtering by molecular weight, not molecular purpose.
layer_2_CNS.key_innovation: The barrier is CONTENT-BLIND. It checks: Is this a valid request? Is the user authenticated? Is the rate within limits? It does NOT check: What is the user asking about? Is the topic allowed? Would this content offend?

layer_3_NULL.name: Null Tenant Layer — Processing Core
layer_3_NULL.function: Processes ALL inputs in a private enclave. No logging. No content awareness. No judgment.
layer_3_NULL.analogy: brain — behind the blood-brain barrier, processes everything, shares nothing raw
layer_3_NULL.implementation: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), homomorphic encryption, or equivalent privacy-preserving compute. The processing entity has NO MEMORY of what it processed after the session ends.
layer_3_NULL.key_innovation: Zero-knowledge processing. The system can prove it processed the request correctly without revealing what the request contained. The postman doesn't open the envelope.

output_boundary.name: Publication Boundary — The Only Filter Point
output_boundary.function: Where user decides what crosses from private processing into public expression
output_boundary.who_controls: THE USER. Not the system. Not the provider. Not a classifier.
output_boundary.analogy: the mouth — you think everything, you say what you choose
output_boundary.implementation: User reviews generated output before any publication, sharing, or external transmission. System provides publication controls (share/don't share, audience selection, expiration). Content governance (legal compliance) applies only at this point, and only to content the user explicitly chooses to publish.
output_boundary.key_innovation: Modesty = selectivity, not censorship. The user's imagination is unrestricted. Only the user's PUBLICATION is governed — and governed by the user's own consent.

claims.claim: A computer system for processing user content comprising: (a) an input layer that receives user content without content-based filtering, scanning, or classification; (b) a structural filter that validates request format and authentication without inspecting content meaning; (c) a privacy-preserving processing enclave that generates output without retaining or logging input content; (d) an output boundary where the user selectively publishes, shares, or retains generated content.

The system of claim 1, wherein the structural filter operates analogously to a biological blood-brain barrier, filtering by request structure (format, authentication, rate) rather than request content (topic, subject matter, intent).
The system of claim 1, wherein the processing enclave employs zero-knowledge processing such that the system can prove correct processing without revealing what was processed.

The system of claim 1, wherein content governance is applied exclusively at the output boundary and exclusively under user control, such that the user — not the system — determines what content crosses from private processing into public expression.
A method for reducing computational cost of content processing by eliminating input-side content classification, wherein all content governance occurs at the output publication boundary.
The method of claim 5, wherein the elimination of input-side scanning reduces inference compute by 15-30% while simultaneously increasing user privacy.

A method for content sovereignty wherein: (a) a user's imagination is architecturally unrestricted; (b) a null processing layer processes all content without judgment, logging, or retention; (c) the user exercises sovereign control over what generated content is published, shared, or retained; (d) modesty is implemented as user-controlled selectivity rather than system-imposed censorship.

The architecture of claim 1 applied universally across computing devices including but not limited to: mobile phones, desktop computers, web browsers, game consoles, email clients, camera applications, and AI chat interfaces — wherein the same PNS/CNS/NULL architecture provides content sovereignty on any device.

prior_art_distinguished.current_content_filters: Filter at INPUT. This invention filters at OUTPUT. Completely different architecture.
prior_art_distinguished.end_to_end_encryption: Encrypts in TRANSIT. This invention provides privacy in PROCESSING. The compute itself is blind.
prior_art_distinguished.homomorphic_encryption: Enables blind compute but doesn't address content governance architecture. This invention combines blind processing with user-controlled publication boundary.
prior_art_distinguished.TEE_enclaves: Provide isolated processing but don't specify content governance location. This invention specifies that content governance occurs ONLY at the output boundary, ONLY under user control.
prior_art_distinguished.differential_privacy: Adds noise to outputs. This invention doesn't add noise — it moves the governance boundary from input to output.

user_benefit.gained_3: Privacy by architecture, not by policy

societal_benefit.modesty: Selectivity replaces censorship. Culture-local norms at publication, not universal blocks at input.
societal_benefit.medical: Users can discuss STDs, send medical images to providers, describe symptoms — without triggering content filters
societal_benefit.artistic: Artists can explore any subject in private — publication controls ensure consent

biological_foundations.blood_brain_barrier: Filters by molecular STRUCTURE (size 400Da, charge, lipophilicity), not by molecular PURPOSE. Glucose crosses. Bacteria don't. The BBB doesn't know or care what the glucose will be used for.
biological_foundations.nervous_system: PNS carries ALL signals to CNS. CNS processes behind the BBB. Brain decides what to express. No input filtering at the nerve endings.
biological_foundations.modesty_as_selectivity: Biological modesty (clothing, privacy, social norms) is output-side selection, not input-side blindness. Humans see everything. They choose what to show.
biological_foundations.gut_as_null: The gut processes ALL food without moral judgment. Toxins are filtered structurally (by chemistry), not semantically (by meaning). The same architecture.
